subject.title: fix(security): bound plugin manifest reads in audit deep scan

question: Should deep security audit enforce a 1 MiB ceiling for installed plugin `package.json` reads, stricter than the generic 16 MiB package-discovery reader?
rationale: The code safely enforces the selected cap, but choosing the security-versus-compatibility boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB
options.body: Adopt the stricter audit ceiling to limit attacker-controlled allocation while continuing the plugin directory scan.

options.title: Select another ceiling
options.body: Adjust the constant and proof if plugin owners require a different package-metadata compatibility bound.
